title: The shared push reader drops redirect tokens before it reads a push's remote and refs
why: #2366 round 3 (lane octopus-merge-push-refused, via the coordinator 20:37 CST Nov 8): `_push_refs` keeps redirect tokens, so `git push origin 2>&1` skips the octopus read and a bare `git push 2>&1` reads `2>&1` as the remote.
note: Filed by triage, Nov 8 20:37 CST. Starts after #2366 merges. Fix in the shared reader, not per guard.
